PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Data Engineering Leader with 14+ years in IT and 7+ years specializing in data platform architecture. Architected and delivered end-to-end data warehouse solutions processing 10,000+ assets daily across Snowflake, Databricks, AWS, and Azure. Led dbt adoption for 40+ engineers with CI/CD automation, reducing deployment errors by 80%. Designed medallion architectures with SCD Type 2 modeling, row-level security, and dynamic data masking for regulated industries. Experienced across HR Analytics, Manufacturing, Digital Asset Management, and Financial Services domains with global stakeholder collaboration.
KEY ACHIEVEMENTS
• Architected dbt infrastructure adopted by 40+ engineers as the standard transformation layer, with CI/CD, coding standards, and comprehensive documentation
• Designed 5-stage serverless pipeline processing 10,000+ digital assets daily with 99.9% uptime and zero data loss over 12 months
• Recovered production SCD Type 2 data after accidental full refresh using Snowflake Time Travel with zero data loss within 1 hour
• Migrated 200+ Informatica PowerCenter workflows to Snowflake/dbt with automated reconciliation framework validating transformation accuracy
• Reduced dbt build times by 60% through slim CI with state:modified selectors and incremental modeling strategies

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Lead Data Engineer, Data Engineering | AuxoAI	   Dec 2024 – Present

Designing integration architecture connecting HubSpot (CRM), DealHub (CPQ), Ironclad (contract management), Bulk Order Portal (fulfillment), and NetSuite (ERP/revenue recognition) into a unified analytical platform on Snowflake
Building end-to-end order tracking models that follow each enterprise deal from sales opportunity through quote, contract, customer-driven fulfillment data, and final revenue recognition in NetSuite
